title: Shinglewake Shore
description: A scalloped sandy lake margin with contrasting wet cobbles, loose shingle and grass tufts. Water is on the negative Y side, at Z=0.

review.notes: Round 3 (final). Fixed: there is now a dark wet-sand band at the waterline; the water is blue-green; wet stones are darker and glossy versus pale dry ones; the bank has a soil cut and root/driftwood pieces. Not fixed: (1) all stones are smooth, rounded blobs (soap/marshmallow look), and the dry stones are almost pure white with no texture; use angular-to-rounded river stones with grey variation and lichen. (2) Pebbles are laid in straight dotted lines that read like footprint trails, not natural clusters along the drift line. (3) The water is a flat opaque teal with no shallow-water transition or shoreline foam where it meets the sand. (4) The root pieces stand like sticks pushed into the bank rather than growing out of the soil cut.
